mediator_designs.rationale: Enforce exact terms when both parties delegate to guarantee exchange; cancel when only one delegates to prevent one-sided exploitation and wasted mediation fees.
If only one side delegates, cancel to avoid being locked into an unfavorable trade. If both sides delegate, execute fairly to guarantee cooperative exchange and reduce defection risk.

Make mediated trades safe and mutually binding only when both parties delegate (execute at offered terms). If only one party delegates, cancel to prevent one-sided exploitation and avoid wasting the mediation fee.

If both sides delegate, enforce the agreed terms to prevent defection and enable reliable exchange. If only one side delegates, cancel to avoid exploitable one-sided mediation outcomes; this keeps incentives consistent across rounds.
Make mutual delegation enforce the exact agreed terms (prevents opportunistic defection), and cancel when only one side delegates to avoid asymmetric, potentially exploitable mediated outcomes.
Fair execution only when both parties delegate (guarantees simultaneous exchange). If only one party delegates, cancel to prevent one-sided exploitation and reduce defection risk.

Fair execution only when both parties delegate (prevents defection and guarantees simultaneous exchange); cancel when only one delegates to avoid being exploited or forced into an asymmetric, risky mediated deal. Adds a predictable constraint with minimal downside.
Enforce offered terms only when both sides delegate (guarantees no defection). If only one side delegates, cancel to avoid asymmetric risk and prevent me from being forced into unfavorable execution.
